title: Constitution of Kenya — Article 31 Privacy
summary: Constitutional foundation for privacy, private/family information and private communications.
caution: Educational summary; a possible privacy issue is not automatically a legal breach or offence.

title: Data Protection Act
summary: Kenya's central personal-data statute covering principles, data-subject rights, lawful processing, controllers/processors, complaints, enforcement and remedies.
caution: Educational summary; apply the current statutory text and facts before reaching a legal conclusion.

title: Data Protection (General) Regulations
summary: Operational rules for consent, data-subject rights, retention, security, controller-processor arrangements and breach handling.
caution: Educational summary; consult the current Regulations and applicable ODPC guidance for procedure-specific questions.

title: Data Protection (Registration of Data Controllers and Data Processors) Regulations
summary: Registration framework for data controllers and processors, including exemptions, registration particulars and the public register.
caution: Absence from a searched public snapshot is not by itself proof that an entity is unlawfully unregistered.

title: Data Protection (Complaints Handling Procedure and Enforcement) Regulations
summary: Procedure for ODPC complaints, investigations, enforcement notices, penalty notices and alternative dispute resolution.
caution: Educational summary; complaint admissibility and remedies depend on the facts and current ODPC procedure.

title: Central Bank of Kenya (Digital Credit Providers) Regulations
summary: Licensing, conduct, credit-information, consumer-protection and customer-information rules for regulated digital credit providers.
caution: A message can be evidence relevant to a DCP conduct question, but the message alone does not establish a regulatory violation.

title: Banking (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations
summary: Rules for credit reference bureaus, subscribers and third-party credit-information providers, including accuracy, disputes and confidentiality.
provisions: summary of rights and dispute provisions
caution: Public CRB-list membership and evidence that a lender submitted a particular person's data are separate facts.

title: Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act
summary: Kenya's principal cybercrime statute on computer systems, unauthorized access/interference, cyber conduct and investigative powers; Kenya Law records a 2025 amendment.
caution: Do not infer a cybercrime merely from an unwanted message, suspected privacy breach or regulatory mismatch; criminal elements require separate analysis.

title: Access to Information Act
summary: Framework implementing Article 35 access-to-information rights for public entities and defined private-body circumstances.
caution: Access-to-information rights and Data Protection Act access rights overlap in some scenarios but are not interchangeable.

title: Consumer Protection Act
summary: General consumer-protection framework relevant to unfair practices, representations, consumer agreements and remedies.
caution: Whether conduct is an unfair practice depends on the representation, transaction and surrounding facts.

title: Kenya Information and Communications Act
summary: Communications-sector and electronic-commerce framework relevant to communications services and electronic transactions.
provisions: current consolidated Act; verify commencement status of specific provision
caution: Check whether the specific provision relied on has commenced and whether later sector regulations apply.
